environment.description: Kubernetes pod running as container image `internal/db-migrator:2.3.1` on EKS cluster. Pod runs with default security context (no securityContext restrictions). Migration XML files are sourced from a shared NFS volume mounted at /opt/app/migrations that multiple teams can write to. The container runs as root with full filesystem access. No AppArmor or SELinux profiles are applied (annotation `container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/migrator: unconfined`).
